editorial.blurb: Chicago's oldest Chinese bakery brings authentic dim sum pastries and baked goods to Argyle, with most items under $3 and lines that move fast despite the crowds.
editorial.insiderTip: Arrive early for the best selection—items sell out quickly. It's cash only and takeout only, so bring bills and come hungry to sample multiple items like their famous BBQ pork buns and sesame balls.
signatureDishes: Sesame balls with red bean paste
